mutations.name: displayNameOf falls back to the payload's own name before the roster lookup, so a peer can relabel another by sending a forged from.name
mutations.replace: if (typeof x === "object") return (x as { name?: string }).name ?? displayNameOf(x.id, idx);
mutations.expectRed: 3.2 displayNameOf resolves an object by its id, never its payload .name
mutations.cell: 3.2 displayNameOf resolves an object by its id, never its payload .name

mutations.name: the stale roster mark loses its observer wording, so the header no longer says which watch went silent or since when
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 Monitor: a stale view marks the roster source, not a peer
mutations.cell: 1.1 Monitor: a stale view marks the roster source, not a peer

mutations.name: waiting and working swap places in STATUS_ORDER, so the Agents view stops leading with who needs a human
mutations.expectRed: 2.7 rows sort waiting first, then working, then idle, each by name
mutations.cell: 2.7 rows sort waiting first, then working, then idle, each by name (the old working-first order is replaced on purpose)

mutations.name: rosterRows includes offline peers by default, so the online-only sidebar grays rows into the list
mutations.expectRed: 2.6 the sidebar rows are online-only by default
mutations.cell: 2.6 the sidebar rows are online-only by default (this change does not gray rows out)

mutations.name: oldestLiveBeat counts offline rows, so a long-gone peer's age fills the golden-signal slot
mutations.expectRed: 2.13 oldestLiveBeat is the stalest heartbeat among live rows, never an offline one
mutations.cell: 2.13 oldestLiveBeat is the stalest heartbeat among live rows, never an offline one

mutations.name: statusLabel adds a progress claim back to a working peer, which no surface can observe
mutations.find: export const statusLabel = (p: Pick<RosterRow, "status">): string => p.status;
mutations.replace: export const statusLabel = (p: Pick<RosterRow, "status">): string => p.status === "working" ? "working · progress unknown" : p.status;
mutations.expectRed: 2.14 statusLabel writes the presence status with no progress claim
mutations.cell: 2.14 statusLabel writes the presence status with no progress claim

mutations.name: an unknown principal's actor is cut to 8 characters, so the short form no longer matches the 6 character rule
mutations.expectRed: 3.5 an unknown owner.actor principal with an actor of 32+ characters is cut to 6 plus an ellipsis
mutations.cell: 3.5 an unknown owner.actor principal with an actor of 32+ characters is cut to 6 plus an ellipsis

mutations.name: a peer missing from the roster is reported idle instead of offline, so a stranger in a DM reads as present
mutations.expectRed: 3.7 dmPeers names, roles and statuses come from the roster by id, never the payload
mutations.cell: 3.7 dmPeers names, roles and statuses come from the roster by id, never the payload

mutations.name: a message a peer sent to itself becomes a conversation, so the roll-up grows a thread with nobody
mutations.expectRed: 3.8 dmPeers rolls pairs up per peer
mutations.cell: 3.8 dmPeers rolls pairs up per peer: only pairs that talked, a self-DM is not a conversation, newest first

mutations.name: a poll drops the observer-view mark, so the next refresh tells the reader the roster is current while the presence watch is still silent
mutations.expectRed: 2.5 a poll cannot erase the observer-view mark
mutations.cell: 2.5 a poll cannot erase the observer-view mark: a refresh keeps the roster entry

mutations.name: the controller stores a presence-view verdict without marking the roster source, so a blind observer shows last-known rows as though they were current
mutations.cell: 2.1 the client applies presence-view events: a stale view keeps the last-known rows and marks the roster source

mutations.name: statusCounts counts a status outside the four again, so the counts gain a NaN entry for it
mutations.find: for (const r of rows) if (STATUS_ORDER.includes(r.status)) counts[r.status] += 1;
mutations.expectRed: 2.11b statusCounts ignores a status outside the four
mutations.cell: 2.11b statusCounts ignores a status outside the four, so no count is NaN and the four are unchanged

mutations.name: an unknown status ranks at -1 again, so a peer with a status the page does not know heads the list above the waiting peers
mutations.expectRed: 2.11c rosterRows sorts a status outside the four after every known one, not first
mutations.cell: 2.11c rosterRows sorts a status outside the four after every known one, not first

mutations.name: dmPeers files a DM under the sender the payload claims, so a peer that writes another's id has its messages filed under that other peer
mutations.expectRed: 3.9 dmPeers files a live DM under its verified senderId, not the payload's from.id
mutations.cell: 3.9 dmPeers files a live DM under its verified senderId, not the payload's from.id
